title: HP Launches ZBook Ultra G3a 16 with 192GB Unified Memory, Easily Handles 300B-Parameter Models Locally
excerpt: The IT industry is entering a period of explosive growth in edge-side AI computing power. HP (Hewlett Packard) officially launched its new mobile workstation mo
content_html:
The IT industry is entering a period of explosive growth in edge-side AI computing power. HP (Hewlett Packard) officially launched its new mobile workstation model - ZBook Ultra G3a16 yesterday local time. This major product, aimed at professional geeks and high-end developers, has attracted widespread attention from the industry due to its top-tier hardware architecture and powerful local large model operation capabilities.

At the core configuration, this model is built around the AMD Ryzen AI Max PRO400 "Gorgon Halo" processor, supporting up to 192GB of unified memory architecture, with 160GB of it being allocated as dedicated graphics memory. This groundbreaking hardware design enables it to smoothly run large language models with parameter scales up to 300B, completely breaking through previous computing power limitations that relied on cloud clusters.

In terms of appearance and portability, the ZBook Ultra G3a16 starts at a weight of 4.2 pounds (about 1.9 kilograms), with a thickness of 17.9mm. The device can provide stable performance of 100W and optionally support 5G cellular network connectivity to meet mobile office needs. At the same time, the design of components such as the keyboard fully considers the modularity for easy replacement.

In terms of software ecosystem and application scenarios, this laptop comes pre-installed with Perplexity Computer's local intelligence agent, and is deeply optimized for professional-level design and visual workflow applications such as Autodesk Revit2027, Autodesk 3ds Max, and Chaos Enscape, providing comprehensive productivity support for architectural design, 3D rendering, and complex AI inference tasks.

According to the information, this mobile workstation is scheduled to be officially released in October 2026. According to the settings of HP's local AI value calculator, the official price of the device is 7,449 US dollars (approximately 50,108 Chinese yuan at the current exchange rate), targeting professional core users who pursue extreme performance and absolute data security.
